priority: fault first when admitting a new output; never preempt an already presented normal record
input_protocol: valid/ready, producer holds data and valid until handshake
output_protocol: registered valid/ready plus is_fault sideband stable under backpressure
reset: coordinated hard reset flushes; no input acceptance during reset
fairness: strict priority; continuous faults may starve normal; no general fairness guarantee
format: opaque data, priority sideband is internal and not a finalized EVENT ABI
integration: standalone; retainer combination tested; core/CDC/PS connection pending
